name: letterboxd-mcp
description: Remote MCP server for Letterboxd, running on Cloudflare Workers

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Choose a unique, strong password for the single owner who authorizes MCP clients.

LETTERBOXD_CLIENT_ID.description: Your Letterboxd API client ID. Request API access at https://letterboxd.com/api-beta/.

LETTERBOXD_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Your Letterboxd API client secret, issued after Letterboxd API access is approved.

COOKIE_SIGNING_KEY.description: Generate a random key with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Required for the secure Letterboxd relink flow.
